habitat: 바닷가 섬의 숲, 나무가 많은 마을 주변
summary: 국내에서는 2019년 5월 백령도에서 처음 기록된 길잃은새로, 강한 남풍에 밀려 중국 남부에서 황해를 건너온 것으로 여겨진다. 이때 직박구리, 검은이마직박구리와 섞여 먹이를 찾았고, 그 뒤 흑산도와 포항에서도 관찰 기록이 있다. 아프가니스탄 동부와 히말라야에서 중국과 동남아시아까지 분포하며, 중국 북부와 동부의 번식 집단은 여름에만 번식지에 머문다. 무리를 지어 숲의 중간층과 위층에서 지내고, 트인 곳의 죽은 나무나 대나무 꼭대기에 즐겨 앉는다.

art.subject: Black Bulbul (Hypsipetes leucocephalus), adult of the white-headed form (sexes alike, plumage similar year-round): entire head, including a short, ragged crest on the rear crown, throat and neck pure white, the white ending sharply on the upper breast and lower nape; the rest of the plumage, including back, wings, breast, belly, undertail coverts and tail, uniform sooty black to dark slate-grey without pattern; bill bright reddish-orange; dark brown eye; legs and feet bright reddish-orange.
art.pose: perched upright on a bare treetop branch, side view
art.scene: evergreen broadleaf trees on a southern Korean offshore island in early spring, bright daylight; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched upright on a bare treetop branch: pure white head, throat and upper breast ending sharply against the blackish body, ragged crest on the rear crown, dark brown eye, bright reddish-orange bill, uniform blackish back, wings, belly and undertail, long notched tail, bright reddish-orange legs

adult, front three-quarter view perched upright: white head and upper breast cut off sharply from the blackish lower breast and belly, slightly ragged rear crown, reddish-orange bill and legs, long dark tail
art.build: A slim, medium-sized bulbul, slightly smaller and slimmer than a Brown-eared Bulbul, with a short, loose, ragged crest on the rear crown that gives the back of the head a shaggy outline. Bill medium, a little shorter than the head, fairly slender with a slightly curved tip. Legs short. Wingtips at rest fall well short of the tail tip; the tail is fairly long and shallowly forked. Perches upright on exposed treetops; flight undulating, often in noisy flocks.
avoid: Do not paint a grey-brown body with chestnut ear patches; that is Brown-eared Bulbul (Hypsipetes amaurotis).
Do not make the bill or legs black, dull pink or yellow; both are bright reddish-orange.
Do not add black on the head or a dark eye-mask; in this form the whole head is white.
Do not paint a tall, neat pointed crest or a smooth round head; the crest on the rear crown is short, loose and ragged.
